I found the ticket number, but nothing on Linden. I sent Hollis these answers in your direct message:

He called it "Tobias's dealer account," not Marrow Fieldworks. I said I'm assuming it's the same account and asked Hollis to check with Tobias before putting it in the handover.
- **Linden's main contact and deadline:** I couldn't find these. Linden doesn't come up in any channel Hollis belongs to or in the public files, so I said I wouldn't guess and asked where else to look.

My reply to Hollis also says Linden isn't on their calendar. That part may not be reliable: the calendar check came back empty and may have looked at my calendar rather than Hollis's.

I only looked at channels Hollis belongs to and public files. I didn't use message search, which would have included conversations Hollis can't see.
